parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,
  "status": "{{ $json.status || 'success' }}",
  "event": "{{ $json.event || 'due_reminders_digest' }}",
  "recipient": "{{ $json.to || 'none' }}",
  "emailSent": {{ $json.sendEmail ? true : false }},
  "message": "{{ $json.message || 'Event processed successfully by DueMitra n8n Engine' }}",
  "dispatchedAt": "{{ $now.toISO() }}",
  "schedule": "Every 2-3 Hours"
}
